{{Short description|none}} {{pp-protected|reason=Persistent [[WP:Disruptive editing|disruptive editing]]|small=yes}} {{Use American English|date=June 2020}} {{Use mdy dates|date=December 2020}} {{Dynamic list}} This article is a list of the top 50 accounts with most followers on the photo and video-sharing social platform [[Instagram]].{{Cite web|url=https://www.trackalytics.com/the-most-followed-instagram-profiles/page/1/|title=The Most Followed Instagram Profiles|website=Trackalytics.com|access-date=April 9, 2020|archive-date=July 1, 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190701132436/https://www.trackalytics.com/the-most-followed-instagram-profiles/page/1/|url-status=live}}{{Cite web|title=Top 50 Most Followed Instagram Business / Creator Accounts (Sorted by Followers Count)|url=https://socialblade.com/instagram/top/50/followers|access-date=January 2, 2021|website=[[Social Blade]]|archive-date=September 4, 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200904174800/https://socialblade.com/instagram/top/50/followers|url-status=live}}{{Cite web|title=Top 50 Most Followed Instagram accounts in 2021 {{!}} TikTokBlade|url=https://insiflow.com/instagram/top|url-status=live|access-date=2021-06-09|website=Social Media Marketing & Management Dashboard|language=en|archive-date=June 9, 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210609172357/https://insiflow.com/instagram/top}} {{As of|2022|12|31|}} the most-followed person is Portuguese footballer [[Cristiano Ronaldo]] with over 526 million followers, and the most-followed woman is American [[reality television]] personality [[Kylie Jenner]] with over 376 million followers. Instagram's own brand account on the platform is the most-followed account overall, with over 585 million followers. [[Nike, Inc.|Nike]] is the second most-followed brand account, with over 260 million followers. A total of 35 accounts have exceeded 100 million followers on the platform, with 20 of those having exceeded 200 million followers, 8 of those having exceeded 300 million, 3 exceeding 400 million and 2 exceeding 500 million. ==Most-followed accounts== File:Cristiano Ronaldo Portugal.jpg|alt=Cristiano Ronaldo is the most-followed European and a footballer on Instagram, with over 504 million followers.|[[Cristiano Ronaldo]] is the most-followed European and also the most followed person in the [[Earth|world]] on Instagram, with over 526 million followers.{{efn|name=CR7|He is also the most-followed man and European on Instagram.}} File:Kylie Jenner Vogue.png|alt=Kylie Jenner is the most-followed North American and also the most followed woman on Instagram, with over 373 million followers.|[[Kylie Jenner]] is the most-followed North American and also the most followed woman on Instagram, with over 376 million followers.{{efn|She is also the most-followed North American on Instagram.}} File:191125 Selena Gomez at the 2019 American Music Awards.png|[[Selena Gomez]] is the most-followed musician and actress on Instagram, with over 367 million followers.
